item.title: How Small, Independent Newspapers Are Still Finding Readers
item.description: In a world of failing newspapers, free weeklies like The Chronicle of Glens Falls, N.Y., are still finding readers. All it takes is owners who do absolutely everything.

item.title: Waymo Is Growing Faster Than Ever. So Are Its ‘Edge Cases.’
item.description: As Waymo deploys more driverless cars to 15 U.S. cities and counting, its vehicles keep encountering new and unexpected situations that they have no script to handle.

item.media:credit: Jason Henry for The New York Times
item.media:description: Waymo driverless cars are in San Francisco and 14 other metropolitan areas, including Denver, Las Vegas, San Diego and Tampa.

item.title: Why Meta Is Betting Big on Open A.I.

item.title: Boeing to Sell 3 Autonomous Flight Subsidiaries

item.title: Kalshi’s Tarek Mansour Isn’t Interested in Management Advice
